Blonding Specialist in Plantation, FL

Blend Hair Boutique is Plantation's trusted destination for blonde hair — from sun-kissed highlights and balayage to full platinum transformations. Our color specialists are trained in bleach and tone, toning, and blonde color correction for every starting color.

Blonding Services

Every Shade of Blonde

Full Blonding

Complete blonde transformation from root to tip. Achievable in one session for lighter starting colors, or safely executed in multiple stages for dark hair.

Bleach & Tone

Precision lightening followed by a professional toning treatment to achieve your exact target — platinum, icy, honey, or champagne blonde.

Blonde Highlights

Dimensional blonde highlights woven through your natural color for a sunlit, multi-tonal effect with a natural-looking grow-out.

Blonde Color Correction

Specializing in correcting brassiness, orange tones, patchy color, and previous blonde gone wrong — safely and precisely.
